title.narrative: Food aid and health bags for residents affected by the earthquake in northern Syria for the year 2024 (second phase)

description.narrative: 647,760 people received food and health assistance, which are as follows: - (134,950) food baskets - (134,950) health bags
Helping needy families to bear the expenses of food for their families and loved ones for three distribution cycles.

The project is an urgent response to those affected by the devastating earthquake that struck northwestern and eastern Syria, in addition to the response to the families that were recently displaced from Idlib. It is considered the second phase of providing food aid and health bags to the population affected by the earthquake in northern Syria for the year 2024 AD. The urgent intervention includes the distribution of baskets. Food and personal hygiene bags, which is consistent with the humanitarian response to northwest Syria for the year 2023.
